items.title: Herb Morand Interview, 1950-03-12
items.q: Lowe Chester's artist, bass player. He's one of the great bass players of New Orleans. He's played with all the different bands.

ctx.x: Well, do you remember anyone else who was in your first band?
Yeah, Lowe Chester's artist, bass player. He's one of the great bass players of New Orleans. He's played with all the different bands. Buddy, Rene, Chris Kelly, and the different bands.
Well, do you remember any of the bands that were playing at the time when you first got interested in music?
